findings.scenario: A caller passes an executor whose run() launches a subprocess. run_helper() invokes it at line 808 even though E3 is blocked and only ContainedExecutor is checked for qualification refusals; the custom executor can perform native effects before the adapter validates its reported outcome.
findings.fix: Make the executable path accept only an implementation that enforces the adopted containment boundary. Keep synthetic executor injection behind a test-only path that cannot be used by normal callers.

findings.scenario: A reader follows the report’s claim that THIRD_PARTY.md omits harness_search.py, although THIRD_PARTY.md lines 59–67 already list the adaptation. The report also lists evidence/t010.json as pending at lines 131–134, although that evidence file exists and records the 2026-11-13 scope decision.
findings.fix: Refresh the report’s provenance and T010 pending statements to match the checked-in third-party record and T010 evidence.
